name: AI chat thread
summary: AI assistant chat card: branded header, empty state with suggestion chips, question typed into the composer with a caret, send press, message lifts into the thread, thinking row with the dotted orb and shimmer text.

params.title: header title (default '<brand> AI')
params.subtitle: header subtitle
params.empty: { title, text, suggestions[] } or null to skip the empty state
params.question: text typed and sent
params.thinking: shimmer text in the thinking row
params.cues: { in, typeStart, typeEnd, send, thinking, out }
params.pace: { enter, exit, stagger, accent } overrides for the PACE timings (seconds)

usage:
import * as chat from '../blocks/chat-thread/index.mjs';
const thread = chat.create(ctx, { subtitle: 'Week 18', question: copy.question, thinking: 'Reading your league', cues: { in: CUE.ask, typeStart: CUE.typeStart, typeEnd: CUE.typeEnd, send: CUE.send, thinking: CUE.thinking, out: CUE.scan } });
changelog: v1 2026-09-26: extracted from the DraftKit showreel ask scene

v2 2026-09-26: readable pacing. Transitions use PACE (entrances about 0.5 s, exits about 0.4 s, staggers about 0.14 s) with a `pace` override, cues.out means fully gone, and default cues and the demo leave time to read.
